steps.en: Notices past the first letter are picked for an electronic reminder
steps.id: Notice yang sudah lewat letter pertama dipilih untuk reminder elektronik
steps.why_en: The system only checks the stage; it cannot prove the first letter was actually delivered.
steps.why_id: Sistem hanya melihat tahap; tidak bisa membuktikan letter pertama benar-benar terkirim.

steps.en: The latest mobile number or email is fetched from the government database
steps.id: Nomor mobile atau email terbaru diambil dari database pemerintah
steps.why_en: This refresh is switched off in every configured environment, so older stored contacts are used.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan ini dimatikan di semua environment yang terkonfigurasi, jadi kontak lama yang dipakai.

steps.en: Contact details are checked before any reminder is sent
steps.id: Kontak dicek dulu sebelum reminder dikirim

steps.en: The check runs by itself every day before reminders go out
steps.id: Pengecekan jalan otomatis tiap hari sebelum reminder dikirim
steps.why_en: The daily schedule is switched off everywhere; it can only be started by hand.
steps.why_id: Jadwal harian dimatikan di mana-mana; hanya bisa dijalankan manual.
